candidate_relations.label: Vogt-Koyanagi-Harada Disease
candidate_relations.reason: VKH typically presents bilaterally with exudative/serous detachments and systemic findings (skin, hearing, meningismus). This patient is unilateral, elderly, with no systemic VKH features, and the detachment became corrugated without breaks found — but the reference diagnosis is rhegmatogenous RD with choroidal detachment, not VKH.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: VKH is a bilateral granulomatous panuveitis with serous detachments; this case is unilateral with features evolving toward rhegmatogenous detachment

candidate_relations.label: Uveal effusion syndrome with exudative retinal detachment
candidate_relations.reason: Uveal effusion syndrome is characterized by exudative (not rhegmatogenous) retinal detachment with choroidal/ciliary body effusions. The reference diagnosis specifies rhegmatogenous RD, which is an incompatible subtype of retinal detachment.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Uveal effusion syndrome produces exudative/shifting RD, not rhegmatogenous; reference specifies rhegmatogenous RD with choroidal detachment

candidate_relations.label: Posterior Scleritis with Retinal Detachment
candidate_relations.reason: Posterior scleritis with retinal detachment implies a serous/exudative mechanism secondary to scleral inflammation. The reference diagnosis is rhegmatogenous RD with choroidal detachment — an incompatible mechanism and subtype, even though scleritis was the initial working diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Posterior scleritis causes exudative/serous RD, not rhegmatogenous; reference specifies rhegmatogenous RD with choroidal detachment

candidate_relations.label: Posterior Scleritis
candidate_relations.reason: Posterior scleritis was the treating diagnosis and may be a contributing or coexisting condition (scleral enhancement on MRI), but the reference final diagnosis is rhegmatogenous RD with choroidal detachment. Posterior scleritis alone is missing the rhegmatogenous RD component and represents only a partial/component relationship.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Posterior scleritis is the initial presumed etiology/component but lacks the rhegmatogenous RD component and is ultimately the incorrect final diagnosis

case_quality_flags: No retinal breaks identified on examination, yet reference diagnosis is rhegmatogenous RD — clinical ambiguity noted; corrugated appearance of RD after steroid treatment is the key clue
